name: Adrammelech
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy

points: “And the Sepharvites burnt their children in fire to Adrammelech and Anammelech”: that’s abortion right there. So when you black women run and open your legs at Planned Parenthood, you’re burning your children, offering them to Adrammelech and Anammelech.

source.name: TIPNR, Translators Individualised Proper Names with all References, by Tyndale House Cambridge, STEPBible.org
